summary: Sprint T-RIM (Tournament Reimbursement Matrix) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases PASSED covering schemes seed, tournament PATCH scheme_code, budgets, invoices with multi-head allocations, tracker computed from allocations, reimbursement-preview summary, claim workflow (create/submit/approve/reject/comment/idempotency/stats). Frontend: All 5 personas visible on /login; Division Secretary sees Tournament Reimbursement Matrix + Reimbursement Claims in sidebar; /tournaments/{id}/finance renders 4 tabs correctly (Budget Sheet, Invoices, Extra Expense, Budget vs Actual) with real seed data (₹5L budget, ₹1.77L invoiced, ₹7K over-budget on Coach honorarium); Scheme Picker modal lists all 10 schemes (2-A through 3-D + 9-BCCI), clicking 2-D creates budget with 16 heads (₹5,86,280 total ceiling); Reimbursement Claims list page (MPCA view) shows 3 approved claims with all 5 status filter chips (Submitted, Under_Review, Approved, Rejected, all); Claim detail renders Summary Sheet (₹5L / ₹1.77L / ₹1.70L / ₹7K), 3 head rows, comment thread (added 3rd comment successfully); Match Official login works — sidebar shows ONLY 'My DA / TA Forms' + 'Tournament Calendar' under MY PORTAL/REFERENCE; DA form edit (days/travel/food/misc/bank) + Save + Submit works — status flips Draft → Submitted (total ₹4,600).

ui_bugs.issue: `edit-misc-{id}` data-testid was MISSING on the misc amount input (spec lists it). Added the attribute (line 126) — trivial fix.

Filter chip data-testids differ from spec — spec (agent context) mentions `finance-filter-*` generically. Actual keys are: `finance-filter-all`, `finance-filter-over-budget`, `finance-filter-with-claim`, `finance-filter-no-budget`. Spec-listed `budget-set`, `invoiced`, `claim-submitted` do NOT exist. If those specific filter keys are required, they need to be added.

issues: Sidebar also shows top-level 'Dashboard' and 'Organisation' items in addition to 'My DA / TA Forms' + 'Tournament Calendar'. Requirement says '…shows ONLY My DA/TA Forms + Tournament Calendar (no Coming Soon)'. Coming Soon items are correctly hidden, but Dashboard/Organisation still appear. Minor deviation — consider whether Dashboard/Organisation should also be hidden for match-official persona.

design_issues.screen: TournamentFinance detail — Budget Sheet after Assign Scheme
issues: `sch.heads` mapping includes one-time prizes (Team prize Winner ₹3.75L, Runner-up ₹1.85L) as `limit_inr` budget-head allocations, which inflates total-ceiling by ₹5.6L on scheme 2-D. Consider excluding lump-sum prize heads from budget ceilings or splitting them into a separate 'prize pool' section.

action_items: Optional: hide Dashboard + Organisation from match-official sidebar for a cleaner focused portal (spec says ONLY 2 items).
Optional: add specific filter chips on /tournament-finance if spec keys `budget-set/invoiced/claim-submitted` are strictly required (currently the semantics are covered by different chip names).
Optional/design: when assigning scheme, exclude lump-sum prize heads (or move them to a distinct 'prize pool' bucket) so total ceiling reflects operational spend caps only.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/reimbursement_claims.py:_compute_summary — invoices are picked up in status {Approved, Submitted}. If a Division submits an invoice but MPCA rejects it, invoice.status becomes Rejected and correctly falls off; however a Draft invoice will NOT count, which is correct. No issue.
backend/routes/reimbursement_claims.py:approve_claim — approved_amount can be 0 (valid). Model allows null to default to full eligible. Well-handled.

frontend/src/pages/TournamentFinanceDetail.jsx:99 — assignScheme maps every scheme head to a budget-head allocation including one-time PRIZE heads (per_team_lump). Because rate_inr for prizes is a one-time payment (₹3.75L Winner, ₹1.85L Runner-up), summing them into total_ceiling_inr inflates the 'budget' unrealistically. Better: filter `sch.heads` to only per-day/per-night/per-match_day units, and surface prize pool separately.
frontend/src/pages/MyDAForms.jsx:126 — the Misc input lacked a data-testid. Fixed inline (added `edit-misc-${f.id}`).

backend/routes/tournament_invoices.py:budget_tracker — allocations are matched by both head_label AND head_code. The current logic will double-count if an allocation has both a label match AND a code match to the same head_row (both branches of the OR would each add). Consider using elif or a set-based dedupe.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows work; only minor test-id / sidebar-scoping deviations)

test_credentials: persona-chip-division-secretary (DIV-IND), persona-chip-secretary (MPCA), persona-chip-match-official (Umesh Bharadwaj) — all working
seed_data_creation: Test tournaments created and cleaned up via API (TEST_TRIM_*, TEST_CLAIM_*, TEST_REJ_*, TEST_SP_*). DELETE endpoint /api/tournaments/{tid} returns 405 Method Not Allowed — same pre-existing gap noted in iter28. Non-blocking for T-RIM verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All T-RIM backend endpoints are fully working. The seeded CT Sarwate Trophy (id 89847570-56c9-4253-9340-044ddbd6695f) demonstrates the full flow with an Approved claim TRC-2025-26-0001 (₹1.65L approved of ₹1.70L eligible). Frontend renders all 4 tabs correctly with real data. Any future work: (1) design decision on lump-sum prize heads in scheme budgets, (2) match-official sidebar minimization, (3) add DELETE /api/tournaments/{tid} for test cleanup automation.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Two minor items: (a) `edit-misc-{id}` data-testid missing on MyDAForms — root cause: line 126 <input> was created without the data-testid attribute while its siblings (days/travel/food/bank) had them — trivial oversight, patched inline. (b) `sch.heads` includes lump-sum prize entries in scheme JSON that are semantically one-time payouts, not spend limits; when assigned as budget ceilings they inflate totals. This is a design/data-model discussion, not a bug — the frontend faithfully sums whatever the scheme JSON declares.
